title: Hˢ Collaborators Studies & Complementary Resources Guide
purpose: Help collaborators quickly locate high-quality, relevant studies and resources that complement the existing work in each collaboration folder. At least 3 suggested studies plus complementary datasets, tools, and communities per entry.
source: Drafted by Grok (AI collective). Integrated honest-broker by Claude 2026-06-18.

_honest_broker_reconciliation.by: Claude (executor); Peter Higgins sole gate — nothing here is contact, submission, or a commitment.
_honest_broker_reconciliation.what_this_is: A LITERATURE/RESOURCE companion: 3 suggested citations + datasets/tools/communities per collaboration folder, to strengthen literature-review and justification sections.
_honest_broker_reconciliation.what_this_is_NOT: This is distinct from the established triangulation discipline ('three to locate'), which means 3 *views* of the real data per domain — View A Navigation (full D), View B Structure (macro amalgamation), View C EITT/boundary — cross-read into a diagnosis. See papers/TRIANGULATION_PROTOCOL.md and papers/TRIANGULATION_LEDGER.md. 'Three studies' (citations) and 'three views' (altitudes of the data) are both useful and should not be conflated; this file is the citation companion, the ledger is the data discipline.
corrections_applied: Removed every use of 'lossless' (Grok's draft used it ~8×). Per the claim-tier standard the per-D=4 chart is exact at the IEEE floor; high-D reconstruction is floating-point (~4.1e-12 at D=1e6), NOT bit-exact identity. Replaced with 'deterministic / locally-exact / reproducible / floating-point at scale'.

Flagged the placeholder entries ('Various', 'Search Google Scholar for X', 'Multiple papers', 'Recent reviews') as NOT citations — they are search leads. Each must be resolved to a specific peer-reviewed reference (author, year, venue/DOI) before it enters any proposal or paper.

Kept and verified-as-real the concrete pointers: PANGAEA 10.1594/PANGAEA.897615 (geology source), ECAM doi 10.1126/scitranslmed.aad7121, NASA OSDR/GLDS-1 (OSD-1), Backblaze drive-stats. Exact titles/years still to confirm at use.
_honest_broker_reconciliation.status: reference companion; tier-3 (to verify) on every non-DOI entry; not a publication artifact until citations are resolved.

note: All suggestions are chosen for scientific rigor and relevance to deterministic high-D reconstruction, CNQ-tiling, or compositional dynamics. They strengthen proposals and give reviewers context. Placeholder ('Search...') entries are leads, not references.

general_recommendations.how_to_use: Start with 'suggested_studies' to strengthen literature-review/justification; resolve every PLACEHOLDER/LEAD to a real reference before it enters a proposal or paper. Use 'complementary_resources' for datasets, tools, communities. Always cross-reference the specific collaboration folder AND the triangulation ledger (the data-side three-views discipline).
general_recommendations.standards: Peer-reviewed papers, public datasets with DOIs, well-maintained open-source tools. No 'lossless' claims. Names of researchers stay OFF the public repo unless they appear as cited published-paper authors. Peter Higgins is the sole contact/submission gate.
